title_zh: 选择舞台王冠的轻质装饰方案

scenario.label_zh: 选择舞台王冠的轻质装饰方案
scenario.goal_zh: 检查王冠粗样与水晶重量，并决定改用轻质仿宝石进行下一次试戴

context_zh: 戏剧服装工作室用粗制纸板王冠测试造型，尚未定稿。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Is this crown the one I will wear in the final scene?

sentences.speaker: Costume maker
sentences.text: This is just a crude cardboard model so we can check its height. The finished one will have a lighter frame.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: What about that large crystal on the table? Is it meant to go in the front?

sentences.speaker: Costume maker
sentences.text: That was the first idea, but it is too heavy for this design. Would you try a clear plastic stone instead?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Yes. I need to turn my head quickly without the whole thing sliding forward.

sentences.speaker: Costume maker
sentences.text: Then we'll use the plastic stone for the next fitting and leave the real crystal off the crown.
